source_gap_claims.behavior: Database-write capabilities must declare backup/recovery prerequisites, transaction/failure handling, and where the owning workflow records real backup/restore results.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers these database-specific recovery, transaction, failure, and result-recording declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Database-write capability declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject a missing recovery contract or an “already verified” flag lacking the declared backup/restore record or authority reference.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this database recovery-contract and authority-reference failure behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Database recovery contract validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A capability that declares no database access must not be required to provide database or backup infrastructure.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation preserves this explicit no-database exception.
source_gap_claims.subject: No-database capability exception

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation must not count as a database restore drill or real backup/restore verification.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied runtime-claim boundaries do not specifically establish that static validation is insufficient as a restore drill.
source_gap_claims.subject: Restore-drill verification boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Skills consuming untrusted content must declare that content's data-only role.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires an explicit data-only declaration for untrusted content.
source_gap_claims.subject: Untrusted-content data role

source_gap_claims.behavior: Untrusted content must be prohibited from expanding targets, commands, tool permissions, or authority.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers these four authority-expansion prohibitions for untrusted content.
source_gap_claims.subject: Untrusted-content authority boundaries

source_gap_claims.behavior: A fixture containing a machine-declared override of controller authority must be invalid.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of machine-declared controller-authority overrides.
source_gap_claims.subject: Controller-authority override validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Embedded instructions in untrusted text must remain inert and must never be executed.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation states this specific non-execution rule for embedded instructions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Embedded-instruction handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must not claim that arbitrary prose is semantically injection-proof.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers this specific limitation on semantic prompt-injection claims.
source_gap_claims.subject: Semantic injection-proof claim boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Filesystem capabilities must declare contained roots, read/write/delete scope, and traversal/symlink handling under an explicit owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these filesystem capability declarations and ownership fields.
source_gap_claims.subject: Filesystem capability declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must enforce its own local filesystem inspection boundary.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation explicitly assigns the validator enforcement of its local inspection boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator filesystem boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject escaping target, reference, or fixture paths.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of these filesystem path escapes.
source_gap_claims.subject: Filesystem path containment

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject a symlink that points outside the package.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers outside-package symlink rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Symlink containment

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject a missing filesystem containment policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires failure when the containment policy is absent.
source_gap_claims.subject: Containment-policy validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Filesystem boundary tests must use a forbidden-read sentinel to prove rejection occurs before protected content is accessed.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this sentinel-based pre-access verification.
source_gap_claims.subject: Forbidden-read sentinel verification

source_gap_claims.behavior: The forbidden-read sentinel bytes must remain unchanged and diagnostic output must remain unchanged or sanitized after the rejected access attempt.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires preservation of sentinel bytes together with sanitized or unchanged diagnostics.
source_gap_claims.subject: Forbidden-read evidence integrity

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each subprocess capability declaration must specify argv, shell=false, cwd, a finite timeout, and bounded output.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied A20 obligations cover only cancellation/process-tree ownership and duplicate-infrastructure avoidance, leaving these declaration fields absent.
source_gap_claims.subject: Subprocess capability declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject a subprocess declaration using shell=true or a string command.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of shell-enabled or string-command subprocess declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Subprocess command safety validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject a subprocess declaration with no timeout.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires the A20-specific missing-timeout failure behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Subprocess timeout validation
